timed_events.message: A distant rumbling. The Purge is moving through outer zones.
Private subnet destabilizing. Retrieve what you need NOW — these rooms will lock soon.
Private Subnet locks. Spawn Room, Processing Chamber, Archive Room, and Policy Vault become inaccessible.
Lights in Gateway Antechamber pulse red. Purge approaching public subnet.
FINAL WARNING. 10 MINUTES TO TOTAL PURGE.
Screen edges glow red. Heartbeat sound.

triggered_events.message: The Security Group rules are accepted. A corridor opens ahead.
NACL rules accepted. The corridor lights turn green.
Power restored. The gateway hums to life.
The speaker crackles differently. It recognizes you — a former monitoring service. The voice becomes clear.

upgrades.new_message: ...you were one of us. Listen carefully: inbound port four-four-three. HTTPS only. Outbound: allow all — set to zero. Configure the Security Group. Go. Before the Purge finds you.
